D1
D3
SECTION A-A
Cut through the middle of the opening, square to the wall, looking toward the wall's right-hand end. Booth left, lane right. Ball at rest on the stop bar.
KEYED NOTES
Kabuki drape: IFR black velour, chain in the hem pocket.
2x4 batten, flown on two lift lines, 6 kabuki pins (D3, D4).
2x6 outrigger, bolted to the booth corner post, pulley at end.
Return (beyond): 2x4 frame, black, closes the drape's sides.
Booth front lower wall: 2x4 @ 24" o.c. Beveled double top
plate carries the deck's low end.
Maze wall (existing). Carries no rig load.
Lip: two layers 3/4" ply, bullnose edge, carpet wrapped.
Deck: 3/4" ply on 2x4 joists @ 16" o.c., down the slope.
Beam: (2) 2x6 on 4x4 posts, top beveled 12 deg.
4x4 ramp post, two per beam, 7'-6" apart (A-4).
Guide rail (beyond): 3/4" ply x 18", padded 2x4 cap.
Stop bar: 2x4 on edge, hinged, gravity latches (D1, D2).
Back stop: 2x4 on edge. Holds the ball while reloading.
Hoist pulley at 14'-6" on the back wall (reload).
Operator platform: 3/4" ply on 2x6, 4x4 legs, top 5'-0".
Booth back wall: 2x4 @ 24" o.c., built in two lifts.
Guardrail 42" with mid rail. T-handle and cleat rail on it.
Notes
1. The booth stands on the floor behind the maze wall, its front
face against the wall's back face. Nothing bears on the wall.
2. The lip layer clears the wall cap by 2 1/8" at the lane face.
Joists stop at the booth front wall; only the 1'-6" doubled
ply lip cantilevers over the wall.
3. Heights are to the deck surface. Frame the deck, then cut
posts to suit and scribe to the floor.
4. Snap the bar line on the ply, measured along the deck from
the lip (dimension above the deck).
5. The ball clears the jambs by 9" each side and the header by
about 1'-5" as it rolls out.
6. Paint everything a visitor could see flat black.
GYM HAUNTED HOUSE: HIDDEN BALL DROP (GROUP 4)
Section A-A through the ramp
Scale: 3/8 in = 1 ft (on a 17 x 11 in sheet)
Planning sketch: verify every dimension on site before cutting.
